RED CARPET — controls printed in the original game

SPACE dismisses the initial stop-the-tape prompt.
S starts from the Red Carpet instructions screen.
Z = LEFT. X = RIGHT. C = DOWN. F = UP.

The replay waits 2.5 seconds for Fuse startup. It presses SPACE for
0.2 seconds, waits 0.7 seconds for the controls, then presses S for
0.6 seconds. It waits 0.7 seconds for the maze. It presses F for
0.18 seconds, then Z for 0.18 seconds. Screen captures before and after
both moves show the white player travelling up and left.
The game runs automatically between keys. Reversing into a new carpet
trail can end play. The replay checks the player's actual position,
not just moving text or the changing score.
